denver-colorado-rockies-pikes-peak-and-d.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This High point near Perry Park → Scenic stretch near Evergreen stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch near Evergreen → Photo stop near Fraser is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

This Photo stop near Fraser → Food stop near Kersey stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Food stop near Kersey → Denver / Colorado Rockies return can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

sections.advice: Denver / Colorado Rockies return → Near Lakewood is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.title: Basque Coast Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 40 km this is Basque Coast Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Chaussée et Tunnel de San Adrian → Cathedrale de Vitoria-Gasteiz
scenicChapters.narrative: 41 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

places-altxerri-pont-de-brinas-sur-le-fl.story: From Zarautz it runs 415 km to Zarautz; allow about 7 h 09 of riding. The stops in between: Chemin de la Côte, Chaussée et Tunnel de San Adrian, Cathedrale de Vitoria-Gasteiz and Pont de Briñas sur le Fleuve Ebro. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
